content.report: Builder phase: shipped the tiny background-color page (index.html, app.js) plus builder tests. Note: the independent test reported one failure — the color-cycle test compares consecutive rgb() values and the app reads body.style.backgroundColor, which the test fixture serializes to rgb(); the app only recognizes hex values in its COLORS list, so after the first click nextColor() falls back to COLORS[1] and repeats instead of advancing, making subsequent clicks not always change the value. The app should read the current color in a form it can compare, or compare against its own tracked state. I have updated app.js to track the current index internally rather than parsing body.style, which makes every click advance the color deterministically regardless of how the browser serializes the value. Files left unexecuted by builder as required.
